PURPOSE: Deterministically derive CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 from the complete canonical finding manifest while preserving product-only P0 findings outside the preactivation control blocker count.
CLASSIFICATION_RULES: Never infer control relevance from severity or filename alone.

CONTROL_BLOCKER requires evidence that the finding affects admission, authority, law/spec identity, control integrity, gating, leases, integration authority, closure authority, canonical roots, control transport, or other preactivation control correctness.
PRODUCT_ONLY requires evidence that resolution is normal product implementation and does not independently affect control authority or activation safety.
SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE requires canonical_blocker_id pointing to an existing semantically equivalent parent blocker; missing/invalid parent downgrades to UNKNOWN.
HISTORICAL_NONBLOCKING requires explicit terminal nonblocking status RESOLVED, CLOSED, or SUPERSEDED; age or legacy origin alone is insufficient.
UNKNOWN is fail-closed and remains control-blocking until evidence-backed classification is published.
P0_CLASS_RULE: A row is P0-class when its authoritative structured severity identifies P0, P0_CONTROL, P0_AUTHORITY, or an explicitly schema-mapped P0 variant. Free-text P0 mentions alone do not establish P0-class.
PROJECTION_RULES: Include CONTROL_BLOCKER rows that are P0-class and whose status is not RESOLVED/CLOSED/SUPERSEDED.
Include UNKNOWN P0-class rows as blocking until classified.
Exclude PRODUCT_ONLY rows from CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 after evidence-backed classification; retain them in product requirement/task accounting.
Exclude valid SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE rows from OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT but retain them in the complete source manifest and bind them to canonical_blocker_id.
Exclude terminal RESOLVED/CLOSED/SUPERSEDED rows from OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT.

COUNTING.DEDUP_KEY: canonical_blocker_id when present and valid, otherwise finding_id
COUNTING.OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT: count of unique projected blocking dedup keys
COUNTING.CONTROL_P0_SET_ROOT_HASH: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JCS(projected manifest) after canonical byte-order sort by dedup key then finding_path

FAIL_CLOSED: Missing finding_id or ambiguous duplicate parent => UNKNOWN.
Any denominator mismatch or incomplete manifest => OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT is UNKNOWN, never zero.
AUTHORITY_NOTE: This schema is an engineering control-plane candidate consistent with V16-RC1.3 [062]-[065]. It does not amend the Constitution and requires independent review before canonical adoption.
